items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: His bop-inflected vocal style upholds the tradition pioneered by King Pleasure, Eddie Jefferson and Jon Hendricks.

ctx.x: Giacomo Gates is a jazz singer in the truest sense of the word. His bop-inflected vocal style upholds the tradition pioneered by King Pleasure, Eddie Jefferson and Jon Hendricks. His latest recording, with original lyrics set to the music of Miles Davis, is entitled “Miles Tones.”
Giacomo was interviewed in Utica, NY on March 29, 2015, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: His bop-inflected vocal style upholds the tradition pioneered by King Pleasure, Eddie Jefferson and Jon Hendricks.

ctx.x: Giacomo Gates is a jazz singer in the truest sense of the word. His bop-inflected vocal style upholds the tradition pioneered by King Pleasure, Eddie Jefferson and Jon Hendricks. His latest recording, with original lyrics, is called “What Time is It?”
Part two was conducted in Utica, NY on November 11, 2017, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
